budget_items.topic: Extra large PAYT bag pilot: initial cost and proposed price
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Minimum order of 50 cases at $75.50 per case for an initial investment of $3775.00, with a proposed charge of $20.00 per roll to recoup cost.
budget_items.quote: the minimum order would be 50 cases at $75.50 per case of 200 bags. this equates to an initial investment of $3775.00 for the town.

budget_items.topic: Proposed charge per roll to recoup bag and hauling costs
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ms. Lemieux proposed charging $20.00 per roll to recoup the cost of the bags and hauling charges.
budget_items.quote: ms. lemieux proposed charging $20.00 per roll.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Zero cost in Year 1, rising to 4 cents per bag in Year 2, and in Year 3 increasing by CPI plus 3% (currently a total 3.5% increase).
budget_items.quote: program at zero cost in year 1 and the increases to 4 cents per bag in year 2.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The textile recycling service is free to the Town, which is paid per ton of textiles.
budget_items.quote: this is a free service and the town is paid $20/ton.

budget_items.topic: Sale of storage cabinets to School Committee

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Use of KP Law legal service is paid from a sewer account, not town funds.
budget_items.quote: he noted their use of this legal service is paid from a sewer account not town funds.
